result.reason: The redline adds reasonable-consent language and, assuming Sparkling is the Customer, an affiliate/successor carve-out. However, it does not prohibit Vendor assignment to a Customer competitor, and Section 3(c) remains an operative, conflicting assignment restriction; a margin comment does not cure that conflict. It also does not meet the fallback because successor assignment is not mutual and no written-notice requirement is included. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve the separate restrictions on transfer, lease, export and sublicensing of the Work.
